title: Method for federated-learning-based mobile edge cache optimization

pse.problem: The limitation is that traditional intelligent algorithms for predicting content popularity in mobile edge computing require sending unprocessed user data to a central server for training, which puts pressure on the network and threatens user privacy.
pse.solution_function: Predict content popularity based on federated learning to cache popular content while protecting client data privacy, reducing network link congestion and request delay.
pse.solution_structure: A layered architecture with each user having a hybrid filtering method on stacked autoencoders for local data training; server aggregates model parameters of clients to build a global model.
pse.solution_implementation: Each user trains local data, predicts content popularity based on local data, the server averagely aggregates model parameters of clients to build a global model, selects the most popular files for edge caching.
pse.effect: Improves user Quality of Experience by reducing network link congestion and request delay while protecting client data privacy
